record.reason: RGAO routes multi-agent code tasks to topologies using a retrieval-derived complexity vector and enforces budget conservation; it reports proxy misrouting reduction from 30.1% to 8.2% and sub-millisecond DAG construction, but end-to-end inference cost/latency savings are not established in the reviewed evaluation.
record.title: Retrieval-Conditioned Topology Selection with Provable Budget Conservation for Multi-Agent Code Generation
